name: CyTools_ViewGenerator
description: Analyse one or more images of the same object and generate new consistent views of it locally.
author: Cyberalien
license: Not declared by the Tool owner
distributionStatus: Experimental: see data/reports/VALIDATION.md for the checks that were actually executed

models.name: Zero123++ v1.2 base model
models.license: Weights CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non commercial); reference code Apache-2.0

platforms.notes: Executed on this machine; see data/reports/VALIDATION.md.
Not executed. The launcher and the installer scripts exist but no Linux run was performed, so nothing is declared as supported.

runtimeRequirements.source: Created by the guided installation ("Install or repair the inference environment"). Holds torch 2.8.0+cu128, diffusers and transformers. The interface interpreter in runtime/python never imports torch or a model. The runtime replaces this relative declaration with the absolute path of the interpreter for the current platform.

operations.name: Analyse the supplied views
operations.description: Segment the object in every supplied image, verify that the images show the same object, place each viewpoint and report the coverage of the sphere with the viewpoints that are still missing.

images.title: Input images

file.title: Image file
file.description: Image path: an absolute local path, or a path relative to data/inputs. The file is copied into the private job workspace automatically; no manual import is required. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 48 MiB and 60 megapixels.

name.title: Name
name.description: Identifier used in the View Set; the file stem is used when it is empty.

view.title: Declared viewpoint
view.description: Declaring the viewpoint is exact and is the recommended input. Auto runs the automatic estimator, which only measures an azimuth for narrow baselines and reports its confidence.

azimuth.title: Azimuth
azimuth.description: Angles in degrees. Azimuth 0 looks at the front of the object and positive values move the camera towards the object right side, so +90 is Right, -90 is Left and 180 is Rear. Positive elevation places the camera above the object.

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.description: Angles in degrees. Azimuth 0 looks at the front of the object and positive values move the camera towards the object right side, so +90 is Right, -90 is Left and 180 is Rear. Positive elevation places the camera above the object.

roll.title: Roll
roll.description: Angles in degrees. Azimuth 0 looks at the front of the object and positive values move the camera towards the object right side, so +90 is Right, -90 is Left and 180 is Rear. Positive elevation places the camera above the object.

fov.title: Horizontal field of view
fov.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees, when it is known.

images.description: One or more images of the same object. Image path: an absolute local path, or a path relative to data/inputs. The file is copied into the private job workspace automatically; no manual import is required. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 48 MiB and 60 megapixels.

segmentation_backend.title: Segmentation backend
segmentation_backend.description: sam2 uses the local SAM 2.1 weights. classical is a GrabCut fallback that needs no model. alpha uses the alpha channel of the supplied image.

device.title: Compute device
device.description: Auto selects CUDA when a device is present. CPU works for segmentation and analysis; generation on CPU is extremely slow and is not validated.

force_same_object.title: Use the images even when they may show different objects
force_same_object.description: Same-object verification reports suspicious images and refuses to generate from them. Enable this to proceed anyway.

keep_input_copies.title: Keep the private input copies after processing
keep_input_copies.description: Private input copies are deleted when the worker stops, including on failure and cancellation. Original files and generated results are never deleted.

outputs.description: Portable View Set: every view with its camera pose, real or generated state, source views, backend, model version and confidence. Consumed directly by other CyTools such as a mesh reconstruction Tool.
Job output directory holding views/, masks/, normals/ and view-set.json.
Contact sheet of every view in the set, for preview only.
The same views as structured records, in View Set order.
Per sector Real/Partial/Generated/Missing state and the coverage percent.

operations.name: Generate the requested views
operations.description: Generate the requested viewpoints of the object locally. Real photographs are reused when they already cover a request, an existing view is mirrored when the object is bilaterally symmetric, and everything else is produced by the selected backend. Each produced view carries the pose that was really achieved, its angular error and a consistency score.

background.title: Background
background.description: transparent writes RGBA using the object mask. neutral composites on a flat grey. original keeps the background the backend produced.

resolution.title: Output resolution
resolution.description: 0 keeps the native resolution of the backend. A larger value only applies when resampling is enabled; resampling adds no detail.

upscale.title: Allow resampling above the native resolution
upscale.description: Lanczos resampling only. This Tool performs no super resolution.

symmetry.title: Symmetry
symmetry.description: auto mirrors an existing view only when the measured silhouette symmetry passes the threshold. force mirrors regardless and marks the result. off never mirrors.

symmetry_threshold.title: Symmetry threshold
symmetry_threshold.description: Minimum silhouette symmetry score accepted for an automatic mirror.

allow_mirror.title: Allow mirrored views
allow_mirror.description: Mirroring an existing view is instant and uses no model, but it assumes bilateral symmetry.

prefer_real.title: Never replace a real view by a generated one
prefer_real.description: When a real photograph already covers a requested viewpoint it is reused instead of generated.

reuse_tolerance.title: Reuse tolerance
reuse_tolerance.description: Angular distance in degrees within which a real photograph answers a requested viewpoint.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: -1 draws a seed. The resolved seed is reported in the outputs and in the View Set so a run can be repeated.

steps.title: Diffusion steps
steps.description: Only used by backends that expose a step count.

guidance.title: Guidance scale
guidance.description: Classifier-free guidance of the generation backend.

variants.title: Variants per view
variants.description: Each variant is a complete generation with its own seed, so the best one can be selected afterwards.

generate_normals.title: Also generate view-space normal maps
generate_normals.description: Uses the Zero123++ normal ControlNet. It also produces a matted alpha channel that is more accurate than the segmentation backend.

normal_guidance.title: Normal guidance scale
normal_guidance.description: Guidance used for the normal pass only.

condition_ratio.title: Object fill ratio of the conditioning image
condition_ratio.description: Fraction of the square conditioning image the object occupies before generation.

file.description: Image path: an absolute local path, or a path relative to data/inputs. The file is copied into the private job workspace automatically; no manual import is required. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 48 MiB and 60 megapixels.

name.title: Name
name.description: Identifier used in the View Set; the file stem is used when it is empty.

view.title: Declared viewpoint
view.description: Declaring the viewpoint is exact and is the recommended input. Auto runs the automatic estimator, which only measures an azimuth for narrow baselines and reports its confidence.

azimuth.title: Azimuth
azimuth.description: Angles in degrees. Azimuth 0 looks at the front of the object and positive values move the camera towards the object right side, so +90 is Right, -90 is Left and 180 is Rear. Positive elevation places the camera above the object.

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.description: Angles in degrees. Azimuth 0 looks at the front of the object and positive values move the camera towards the object right side, so +90 is Right, -90 is Left and 180 is Rear. Positive elevation places the camera above the object.

roll.title: Roll
roll.description: Angles in degrees. Azimuth 0 looks at the front of the object and positive values move the camera towards the object right side, so +90 is Right, -90 is Left and 180 is Rear. Positive elevation places the camera above the object.

fov.title: Horizontal field of view
fov.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees, when it is known.
